title: feat: add ViewDesigner for visual view creation and editing in console
body:
Console lacked any UI for creating or modifying list views — view definitions were code-only. This adds a visual ViewDesigner and wires it into the console with routes and toolbar entry points.

### Types (`@object-ui/types`)
- New `ViewDesignerSchema` and `ViewDesignerColumn` interfaces in `designer.ts`

### ViewDesigner Component (`@object-ui/plugin-designer`)
- 3-panel layout: field palette → column layout preview → properties panel (columns/filters/sort/options tabs)
- Supports all 7 view types with type-specific options (e.g. Kanban `groupBy`, Calendar `startDateField`)
- Registered with `ComponentRegistry` as `view-designer`

### Console Integration
- `ViewDesignerPage` wrapper resolving object fields from route params
- Routes: `/:objectName/views/new` and `/:objectName/views/:viewId`
- "Edit View" / "Add View" buttons in ObjectView toolbar

```tsx
// Navigate to designer from any object list view
<Button onClick={() => navigate('views/new')}>Add View</Button>
<Button onClick={() => navigate(`views/${activeViewId}`)}>Edit View</Button>
```

### Tests
- 30 tests covering field palette, column management, view type selection, save/cancel, filters, sort, options, and edit mode
